describe: make the player move faster or slower

params.question: Does the message want the player to end up faster or slower?

guide: Find the number the arrow keys move the player by -- usually a constant like PLAYER_SPEED near the top -- and change only that number.
Change the constant's line exactly as it is written; do not add indentation to a line at the top of the file.
report: I $direction $name from $old to $new. It is near the top of the game file if you want to try other numbers.
$name was $old; it is $new now. Try a few other numbers there and see which feels right.
Done -- $name is $new now, up from $old. That one number sets how far the player moves each frame.
teach: $name is how many pixels the player moves each frame while an arrow key is held, so a bigger number covers more ground.
